description: This Java class 'IniFileModel' reads and parses an INI configuration file ('rusefi.ini'), manages dialog and field data, and provides access to dialog models. It includes methods for reading the file, handling lines, and constructing dialog objects.

classes.name: IniFileModel
classes.description: Main class for reading and managing INI configuration dialogs and fields.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for testing, prints dialogs.

methods.name: readIniFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the INI file, populating dialogs and fields.

methods.name: finishDialog
methods.description: Finalizes the current dialog, storing it in the dialogs map.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Processes a line from the INI file, handling dialog or field entries.

methods.name: handleField
methods.description: Processes a 'field' line, adding a field to the current dialog.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.description: Processes a 'dialog' line, starting a new dialog context.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes empty tokens from the start of a list.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IniFileModel.

methods.name: getDialogs
methods.description: Returns the map of dialog IDs to DialogModel objects.
